description: HashiCorp Vault audit-device events. Vault audit logs are pushed by a sidecar tailing the file/socket device into the connectors service buffer; this connector drains the buffer per poll. test_connection verifies the cluster health and token policy via the Vault REST API.

fields.help_text: Cluster URL used by test_connection. Can be left blank to skip the live probe.
fields.label: Vault address
fields.name: vault_addr

fields.help_text: Token with sys/audit list / sys/health read. Used only by test_connection — events flow via the audit-device sidecar, not through this token.
fields.label: Vault token (audit-list policy)
fields.name: vault_token

fields.help_text: Optional. Sent as X-Vault-Namespace.
fields.label: Vault Enterprise namespace
fields.name: namespace

description: Wazuh — open-source XDR/SIEM. Pulls alerts from the Wazuh indexer (OpenSearch-compatible) and maps the 0-15 rule level onto the AiSOC severity ladder.

fields.help_text: Base URL of the Wazuh indexer (NOT the dashboard or manager). Default port is 9200.
fields.label: Wazuh Indexer URL
fields.name: indexer_url

fields.help_text: Indexer user with read access to wazuh-alerts-*. Create a dedicated read-only role in production.
fields.label: Indexer Username
fields.name: username

fields.help_text: Override only if you have re-templated the default Wazuh index naming.
fields.label: Alert Index Pattern
fields.name: index_pattern

fields.help_text: Drop alerts with rule.level below this value at ingest. Default 7 keeps low-signal noise out of the lake; lower to 3 for full audit coverage.
fields.label: Minimum Rule Level
fields.name: min_rule_level

fields.help_text: Disable only for self-signed lab clusters. Production deployments must install the CA chain.
fields.label: Verify TLS Certificate
fields.name: verify_tls

description: Pull Windows Security + Sysmon events from a Windows Event Forwarding (WEF) collector's JSON spool endpoint. Severity is derived from channel + Event ID (log clears, service installs, process injection floored appropriately).
Wiz cloud security issues via the GraphQL API.

fields.help_text: Your tenant's GraphQL API endpoint.
fields.label: API Endpoint URL
fields.name: api_endpoint_url

fields.help_text: OAuth2 token endpoint. Override only for gov-cloud tenants.
fields.label: Auth URL
fields.name: auth_url

description: Pull network-detection events from a Zeek (notice.log) or Suricata (eve.json alert) sensor's JSON spool. Suricata alert severity (1=highest) and Zeek notice types map to the five-tier ladder.
Zscaler Internet Access web security logs via the ZIA API.

fields.help_text: ZIA cloud domain (e.g. zscloud.net, zscaler.net).
fields.label: ZIA Cloud
fields.name: cloud
